versions.changelog:
ttscn 1.3.2

- Added improvements and updates to TTS backend logic, including updates to the MiniMax backend.
- Adjusted output handling logic in scripts/output.py for improved processing.
- Documentation refinements in SKILL.md.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md file.

Critical: repair synthesis pipeline broken since v1.0 JSON refactor (dependency check used pip names as module names — 5/8 backends always failed; get_synthesize_func import anchor broken for all 8; --format mp3 silently wrote WAV). Also: skill-root-relative paths in SKILL.md, MINIMAX_API_BASE support for China site, corrected MiniMax clone docs (10s-5min audio, 7d global / 48h China activation window), baidu-aip chardet hint, tool_missing exits 2.

Voice cloning: new 'clone' command group for MiniMax (local file, paid, --yes gated) and CosyVoice (free enrollment via public URL). Named voices stored in ~/.ttsCN.json and resolved automatically by --voice <name>; CosyVoice voice/model pairing enforced. Also: --help crash fix, drawio workflow diagram, README standardization.

v1.2.0 — Agent-Native CLI: JSON envelope, distinct exit codes (0/1/2/3/4), schema introspection, --idempotency-key, compact list with --full, --yes/--no-input, meta.schema_version. 8 China-friendly TTS backends with full capability matrix (SSML, clone, emotion, dialects).
